SV-11466.description:
h3. What

Make Board View's sideways scrollbar easier to see and grab: twice as thick, with a grab handle that never gets shorter than 150px.

h3. Expected

S3-E2: "The board's sideways scrollbar is 16px thick, and its grab handle is never shorter than 150px at any screen width or number of technician columns. When more of the board fits on screen, the handle is longer, as the browser draws it. The scrollbars inside each column are unchanged. Firefox shows its own standard scrollbar."

PRD: [Board View & Tech View PRD v64|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (S3-E2). Before and after, drawn to size: [Board View Scrollbar|https://claude.ai/artifact/HJieHb5UrXsKjiNBqPT7FC].

h3. Actual (local build on develop, 2026-10-16)

The board uses the app's global scrollbar: 8px thick, with a handle that shrinks with the share of the board on screen. With 55 technicians the handle is 142px at a 1920px wide screen, 67px at 1440, 48px at 1280 and 25px at 1024.

h3. How to check

* Board View with many technicians (55 on Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, All tab): the sideways scrollbar is 16px thick and its handle is 150px long at 1920, 1440, 1280 and 1024 wide.
* With few enough technicians that most of the board fits on screen, the handle is longer than 150px, never shorter.
* Dragging the handle end to end scrolls the board from the first to the last technician; Unassigned stays fixed.
* The scrollbars inside each column are unchanged, and nothing changes in List or Tech View.
* Light and dark theme both show the bar (see SV-11430 for the dark-theme column scrollbars).

comments.body: [~accountid:712020:b2d16ade-9013-4875-8a9d-e255e63e8217] [~accountid:712020:6d590212-5c9b-4135-ae11-277f3826110e] for QA: please test this against PRD v63 S3-E2 once it is ready. The "How to check" list in the description is what passing looks like.

[~accountid:712020:aa00b8d6-a71f-4259-8919-82a304227c20] a question before I build this. A browser's own scrollbar can be 16px thick and have a handle of at least 150px, but it can't stop the handle from growing: the handle grows with how much of the board fits on screen, so on a board with fewer than about 50 technicians it is longer than 150px (for example about 830px when the board is only a little wider than the screen).

Two options:

# *(A)* 16px with a handle of at least 150px. It is never too small to grab, but longer on small boards. Small change.
# *(B)* Our own scrollbar with a handle that is always exactly 150px, as S3-E2 says. A bigger change.

Is (A) enough, or do you want (B)?

[~accountid:712020:1b27a800-7b5a-43f3-982a-81e7071a4fdb] good catch, thanks. Go with (A): 16px thick and a handle of at least 150px, on the browser's own scrollbar. A longer handle on a small board is fine; the problem was the handle getting too small to grab. I've updated the description and [PRD v64|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] S3-E2 to match.

SV-11467.description:
Found while testing [SV-11318|https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11318]

h3. Summary
In Tech View at Compact density, the red and blue count bubbles on a work order's status pill cover most of the status name. On a Ready For Review pill they sit over the word "view", so the status is hard to read. At Regular and Comfortable, and in the List, the bubbles only touch the top of the letters and the status stays readable.

h3. Steps to reproduce
Open Staging: https://app.staging.shopview.com (window about 1600 px wide, browser zoom 100%).
# In the top menu, click *Work Orders*, then the *All* tab.
# On the right of the bar above the list, click the second of the three view buttons (the person icon) to open *Tech View*.
# Click the density button (the icon just right of *Asset on Site*) and choose *Compact*.
# Click *Search* (the magnifying glass) and type *S2-33351*. If the *Unassigned* group is closed, click the small arrow to the left of *Unassigned* to open it.
# Look at the status pill in the first column of that row: the red *2* and blue *3* bubbles sit on top of the word "Review".
!01-count-bubbles-cover-status-compact-hd.png|width=380,height=454!

*Fastest way to see it:* open https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders?search=S2-33351 (the search is filled in), switch to *Tech View*, set density to *Compact* and open the *Unassigned* group.

h3. Expected behaviour
The count bubbles sit on the pill's corner and the status name stays readable at every density, the same as on the List's pill.
*Where this comes from:*
* Spec "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", version 64, S2-R19: Tech View's Status column is _"the same status pill List shows in production, with the same red service-actions count and blue parts-actions count on it. Its size follows density (S6-R2a)."_
* Same spec, S6-R2a: _"In Tech View the status pill is 16px tall at Compact and Regular and 22px tall at Comfortable … only its height follows density."_

h3. Current behaviour
At Compact the pill is 16 px tall and the 19 px bubbles sit lower on it than on the List's pill, so they cover most of the word.
||Where (Staging, 16 Oct 2026)||Pill height||What you see||
|Tech View, Compact|16 px|bubbles cover "view"|
|Tech View, Regular|16 px|bubbles touch the top of "view"|
|Tech View, Comfortable|22 px|bubbles touch the top of "view"|
|List (same as Production)|21 px|bubbles touch the top of "view"|

Tested on Staging, build v26.40.19-754919e, 16 October 2026.

SV-11422.description:
h2. Description

*In Tech View, the one Tab stop should land on a work order row* — the row last focused, or the first row when none has been — and that row shows the focus ring. On staging the first Tab lands on the *Unassigned* group header instead, even when Unassigned has a work order row under it.

For example,

* Tech View shows the Unassigned group with one work order row under it
* pressing Tab from the Search box puts the blue focus ring on the Unassigned group header, not on that row
* Board View does this correctly: the first Tab lands on the first card

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, type {{ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Reach}} in *Search* and click *Tech View*.
#* The Unassigned group shows one row, {{S2-36336}}.
# Click once in the *Search* box and press Tab until focus enters the table.
#* The blue focus ring is on the *Unassigned* group header.
#* No work order row has the focus ring.

*Actual Result:*

* The first Tab into Tech View lands on the Unassigned group header.

*Expected Result:*

* The first Tab into Tech View lands on a work order row (here the first row, S2-36336), with a visible focus ring.

h2. Screenshots

!C97021-3-tech-first-tab-lands-on-header.png|width=1962,height=1084!

h2. Environment

* *Build:* {{v26.40.18-7d85b7d}} on [staging|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders] · *Location:* Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 · *User:* Admin · seen 16 Oct 2026

h2. Sources

* [PRD – Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (Confluence page 845185030, version 58, read 16 Oct 2026), S11-R1:
Each view is a single Tab stop. Tab lands on one work order row (Tech View) or card (Board View), the one last focused, or the first one when none has been; the focused row or card shows a visible focus ring.

h2. Test case

* [C97021 Tab reaches every card, row and header in on-screen order with a focus ring|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/97021]

[~accountid:712020:b2d16ade-9013-4875-8a9d-e255e63e8217] [~accountid:712020:6d590212-5c9b-4135-ae11-277f3826110e] for QA: test against [PRD v60|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] S11-R1.

[~accountid:712020:aa00b8d6-a71f-4259-8919-82a304227c20] two details:

# After arrowing onto a group header and tabbing out and back in, focus returns to a work order row, not the header, while any row is shown.
# On Board View, if the last-focused card has scrolled out of its column, Tab lands on the first card in view.

OK?

[~accountid:712020:1b27a800-7b5a-43f3-982a-81e7071a4fdb] both OK: Tab returns to a row after leaving a header, and on Board View it lands on the first card in view when the last-focused card has scrolled away. Written into S11-R1, [PRD v61|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030].

{panel:bgColor=#fffae6}
*OVERALL QA STATUS: PARTIALLY PASSED*
{panel}

The details of what passed are below. The one thing still to be fixed is posted in a separate comment below this one.

Tested on Staging (build v26.40.19-31ad1e1) on 19 October 2026, against the spec (version 64), signed in as Admin.
* In Tech View the first Tab now lands on a work order row, not the Unassigned header, whenever the row is on the screen.
* Board View, tabbing back in, and the all-collapsed case work as Chris described.
* When the first work order is listed but further down the page, out of sight, the first Tab still lands on the empty "Unassigned" header (Tech View) or column header (Board View).

*Before and after*
_Updated on 18 October 2026, 23:03 CDT: the picture now says which part is BEFORE the fix and which is AFTER._
!sv11422-01-first-tab-v2.png|width=1024,height=1394!
_Staging today, Admin. 1 (green): with rows in Unassigned the first Tab lands on the first row, S2-37015; the ticket's picture showed the ring on the Unassigned header here. 2 (red): search S2-16688, Unassigned is empty and the only work order is far down the list; the first Tab lands on the "Unassigned" header. 3 (green): the same search with S2-16688 scrolled onto the screen; Tab lands on the row. 4 (red): Board View, the same search; the first Tab lands on the "Unassigned" column header while the card is in Brandi Smith's column far to the right. Window 1440 x 900 px, zoom 100%._

*What I checked*
||#||Check||Status||
|1|Tech View, rows in Unassigned (ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Reach): the first Tab from the Search box lands on the first row, S2-37015, with the blue focus ring.|PASSED|
|2|Tech View: arrow up onto the Unassigned header, Shift+Tab out, Tab back in: focus returns to the row S2-37015, not the header.|PASSED|
|3|Tech View, every group collapsed: the first Tab lands on the first group header (Unassigned).|PASSED|
|4|Tech View, a row focused further down (S2-16218, search Lamkin), Tab out and back in: focus returns to S2-16218.|PASSED|
|5|Board View, first Tab (ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Reach): lands on the first card, S2-37015.|PASSED|
|6|Board View, the last-focused card scrolled out of its column: Tab lands on S2-33099, the first card fully in view (the card above it, S2-35104, is half cut off at the top of the column). With the card still in view, Tab returns to it.|PASSED|
|7|Tech View, Unassigned empty and the first work order listed below the visible part of the page (search S2-16688, 2 fresh loads): the first Tab lands on the "Unassigned" header. Once S2-16688 is scrolled onto the screen, Tab lands on it.|FAILED|
|8|Board View, the same search: the first Tab lands on the "Unassigned" column header; the only card is in Brandi Smith's column, off to the right.|FAILED|

*Where the expected result comes from*
Spec "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", version 64:
{quote}S11-R1: Each view is a single Tab stop. Tab lands on one work order row (Tech View) or card (Board View), the one last focused, or, when none has been, the first work order shown in on-screen order: the first row or card in Unassigned, or the first technician's first row or card when Unassigned is collapsed or empty (never a group or column header while a work order is shown; when every group is collapsed, Tab lands on the first group header; after the user arrows onto a header and tabs out and back in, Tab returns to a work order row while any row is shown; on Board View, if the last-focused card has scrolled out of view in its column, Tab lands on the first card in view); the focused row or card shows a visible focus ring.{quote}
Chris Ward in this ticket (16 October): "The Tab stop must land on a work order row, never the Unassigned header while a row is shown." His later answer to Slavcho is written into the same rule.
The spec uses "shown" for the work orders listed in the view ("a count of the work orders currently shown in that group … so the count always matches the rows listed", S2-R12) and says "in view" when it means on the screen (the Board View case above). S2-16688 is listed, so it counts as shown.

*How to see it yourself*
# Open Staging: https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders and click the *All* tab (top left).
# In the *Search* box above the list type {{S2-16688}}.
# On the right of that bar, click the *Tech View* button (the middle of the three view buttons, a person icon).
# Click once in the *Search* box, then press Tab until the blue focus ring appears in the table: it is on the "Unassigned" header (0 work orders), not on S2-16688.
# Scroll down to Brandi Smith's group until S2-16688 is on the screen, click the *Search* box again and press Tab: the ring is now on S2-16688.
# Click the *Board View* button (the right view button) and repeat step 4: the ring is on the "Unassigned" column header.

*Screen recording*
!sv11422-first-tab-staging-recording-voiceover.mp4|width=1280,height=800,alt="sv11422-first-tab-staging-recording-voiceover.mp4"!
_Staging, build v26.40.19-31ad1e1, 19 October 2026, Admin, window 1440 x 900 px, zoom 100%: the first Tab with rows in Unassigned, then search S2-16688 (Tab lands on the header; then on the row once it is on screen), then Board View (Tab lands on the column header; the card is shown in Brandi Smith's column). Each caption is read from the page. With voice-over._

[~accountid:712020:1b27a800-7b5a-43f3-982a-81e7071a4fdb] *Remaining issue to be fixed*

*What's happening:*
* When Unassigned is empty and the first work order is listed further down the page (out of sight), the first Tab lands on the empty "Unassigned" header in Tech View, and on the "Unassigned" column header in Board View, instead of on that work order.
* Example on staging: search {{S2-16688}} (its only work order sits in Brandi Smith's group or column).

!sv11422-02-off-screen-row.png|width=512,height=704!
_Top (Tech View): the first Tab is on the "Unassigned" header; S2-16688 is far below. Bottom (Board View): the first Tab is on the "Unassigned" column header; the card is in Brandi Smith's column off to the right._

*Steps:*
# Staging → *Work Orders* → *All* tab.
# In *Search* type {{S2-16688}} and click *Tech View* (the middle view button, a person icon).
# Click once in the *Search* box and press Tab until the blue focus ring appears in the table: it is on the "Unassigned" header.
# Click *Board View* (the right view button) and do the same: the ring is on the "Unassigned" column header.

*What it should be:*
The first Tab lands on S2-16688 (scrolled into view), because a work order is listed. Spec version 64, S11-R1:
{quote}… or the first technician's first row or card when Unassigned is collapsed or empty (never a group or column header while a work order is shown …){quote}
Chris in this ticket (16 October): "The Tab stop must land on a work order row, never the Unassigned header while a row is shown."
